item.title: MD Traffic Deaths Drop 18% to 480 in 2025
item.description: Annapolis, Maryland – Governor Wes Moore announced February 4, 2026, that preliminary data show Maryland traffic fatalities declined by about 18 percent in 2025, dropping from 582 deaths in 2024 to 480, the first time the annual total has fallen below 500 since 2014 and placing it among the five lowest yearly counts since 1960.
